candidates.title: [ux-sim] On a plan, "Going" looks like a status, joins instantly, and the count disagrees ("1 going" vs "0 joined")
candidates.body:
> **AI 시뮬레이션 — 실제 사용자 측정이 아닌 가설.** 이탈 가능성은 가설로만 적습니다.

> **AI simulation — hypotheses, not measured user behaviour.** Curated from AI personas driving a real browser — a hypothesis to confirm with real students, not measured behaviour.

### Problem

Minji today, Aisha on 2026-11-04: both unsure whether "Going" was already set or the button, and both saw the list and detail counts disagree.

Severity **2** (Moderate — slowed me down or made me hesitate; I recovered on my own.) · analyst confidence high · **1 simulated persona(s)** across 1 scenario(s).

### Root cause (hypothesis)

Same label for state and action; the list counts the host, the detail page does not.

### Evidence

- run `sched-20261105-1915-minji-lunch-today` step 3 — “뭐지, list said '1 going' but here it says '0 joined · cap 4'. is anyone actually coming? and the big lime 'Going' — did” [screenshot](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261105-1915-minji-lunch-today/shots/003-click.jpg) · [marked](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261105-1915-minji-lunch-today/shots/003-click-som.jpg)

Runs: [`sched-20261105-1915-minji-lunch-today`](https://github.com/chaeyeon573/AroundU/blob/claude/ux-sim/ux-sim/runs/sched-20261105-1915-minji-lunch-today/report.md)

### Who

Personas: `minji-freshman-17` · scenarios: `lunch-today`

### Environment note

Same on live.

### Suggested fix (hypothesis)

Label the action "Join lunch"; count the host the same way on both screens.

### Note

Severity and persona counts describe simulated personas, not rates of real students. Re-run the affected cells after a fix and compare (docs/ux-sim/ORCHESTRATE.md).
